title: OPS-02 External Data Source Evaluation and Acquisition Scoring Framework
purpose: Provide a rigorous, multi-criteria quantitative evaluation framework for assessing public SAR datasets and acquisition archives before ingesting candidate scenes into OPS-02.

scoring_rubric.scale: 1 to 5 per criterion (Total maximum score: 70 points)

criteria.name: Source Authority and Institutional Backing
criteria.description: Peer-reviewed scientific publication, official space agency archive (ESA/Copernicus, NASA/ASF), or established academic research repository.

scoring_levels.5: Official space agency archive or peer-reviewed publication with published open DOI.
scoring_levels.3: Academic institutional archive with documented research methodology.
scoring_levels.1: Anonymous or unverified third-party web repository.

criteria.name: Parent Scene Traceability
criteria.description: Ability to trace derived tiles/crops back to the exact physical Level-1 product identifier and raw acquisition.

scoring_levels.5: Complete ESA product ID (S1A_IW_GRDH_...) and datatake ID provided for every patch.
scoring_levels.3: Product ID can be unambiguously reconstructed via acquisition time and bounding coordinates.
scoring_levels.1: Orphan patches with no parent scene identifier. (AUTOMATIC REJECTION)

criteria.name: Physical Imagery Availability and Radiometric Integrity
criteria.description: Availability of raw float/int Level-1 GRD raster data vs lossy compressed 8-bit visual images.

scoring_levels.5: Original 16-bit GeoTIFF Level-1 GRD with full calibration metadata.
scoring_levels.3: Linear downsampled GeoTIFF with preserved dynamic range.

criteria.name: Annotation Quality and Verification Level
criteria.description: Pixel-level manual segmentation by domain oceanographers vs coarse bounding boxes or weak pseudo-labels.

scoring_levels.5: Expert manual pixel-level segmentation with multi-annotator cross-validation (Tier A).
scoring_levels.3: Semi-automated pipeline verified by oceanographic specialists (Tier B).
scoring_levels.1: Unverified model-generated pseudo-labels or coarse bounding boxes (Tier D). (AUTOMATIC REJECTION)

criteria.name: Acquisition and Sensor Metadata Completeness
criteria.description: Availability of acquisition timestamp, orbit direction, relative track, polarization, and incidence angles.

scoring_levels.5: 100% of acquisition, orbital, and geometric metadata parameters fully specified.
scoring_levels.3: Timestamp and orbit available; secondary geometry missing but derivable.
scoring_levels.1: Missing acquisition date/time or spatial coordinates.

criteria.name: Geographic Ontology and Coordinate Validity
criteria.description: Accurate bounding coordinates, ocean basin naming, and regional sea attribution.

scoring_levels.5: Exact WGS-84 polygon boundaries with standardized IHO ocean/sea attribution.
scoring_levels.3: Approximate centroid coordinates with regional sea label.

criteria.name: Taxonomy Compatibility with OPS-01 Ontology
criteria.description: Degree of direct 1-to-1 semantic alignment with canonical classes (BG, AF, BS, LWA, MCC, OF, POW, RF, WS, Eddy, IWs, HM).

scoring_levels.5: Exact semantic 1-to-1 match with canonical OPS-01 class definitions.
scoring_levels.3: Well-defined subsets or superclasses that can be mapped with strict filtering.
scoring_levels.1: Ambiguous, conflated, or incompatible phenomenon definitions. (AUTOMATIC REJECTION)

criteria.name: Overlap and Duplication Risk with Existing OPS-01 Dataset
criteria.description: Risk of ingesting acquisitions already represented in OPS-01, especially against the protected HOLDOUT.

scoring_levels.5: Geographically and temporally distinct from all OPS-01 parent acquisitions.
scoring_levels.3: Candidate shares broad regional archive; requires automated spatial/hash deduplication.
scoring_levels.1: High risk of containing disguised duplicates of protected HOLDOUT parent scenes.

criteria.name: Licensing and Intellectual Property Permissibility
criteria.description: Open science license allowing commercial and non-commercial derivation, redistribution, and research.

scoring_levels.5: Public Domain (CC0) or Open Data Commons / Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY).
scoring_levels.3: Academic research use permitted with attribution (CC-BY-NC).

criteria.name: Automated Access and Download Reliability
criteria.description: Availability of stable programmatic APIs (e.g. Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem, Zenodo API, ASF Vertex) vs fragile manual web downloads.

scoring_levels.5: Stable programmatic REST API or S3 bucket with high-throughput bulk access.
scoring_levels.3: Reliable HTTP archive with persistent URLs.
scoring_levels.1: Fragile manual forms or dead links.

quarantine_triggers: Any dataset scoring < 3 on CRIT_02 (Parent Traceability) must be immediately QUARANTINED.
Any dataset scoring < 3 on CRIT_04 (Annotation Quality) must be immediately QUARANTINED.
Any dataset with ambiguous class definitions that conflate mineral oil with natural slicks must be QUARANTINED.
